final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro is a local AI trading desk with cockpit UI, live sentiment telemetry, market data, Bob, committee, guardrails, broker demo/paper integration, and learning loop.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 and supervised operators validating Bob inside IBKR Demo/Paper before any live-money escalation.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open cockpit on http://127.0.0.1:8002, inspect Genie/Deep/chart/IBKR demo portfolio, ask or order through Bob, let the full pipeline/committee/guardrails run, then review stream, portfolio mirror, trace, and journal.
final_objective.proof_output: /task/submit streams a Bob answer, /task/active returns count=0 after stream completion, and the cockpit does not render active-session 429 as a Bob failure.

what_was_done: Investigated the cockpit error shown by Marco: /task/submit 429 with 'Session already has an active task'.
Confirmed the live API had active Bob tasks stuck in /task/active and cancelled them to unblock the cockpit.
Found the root cause: submit_task registered tasks in TaskQueue but the normal stream path did not call tq.complete() after STREAM_END.
Fixed TaskQueue to clean expired session tasks and expose active_for_session() for structured busy-state reporting.
Fixed /task/submit to return structured 429 detail with code=active_task, run_id, session_id, and elapsed time.
Fixed the normal stream, error stream, disconnect path, and 'o que houve' intercept path to release the TaskQueue entry in finally.
Added run_id to STREAM_START and STREAM_END so frontend/runtime panels can tie the visible stream to the queue task.
Updated frontend API error parsing to preserve status, code, runId, sessionId, elapsed, and detail.
Added cockpit-side bobBusy locking so button/Enter cannot submit parallel Bob requests from the same tab.
Changed the active-task UI path to show a local operational notice instead of 'Bob failed to produce a valid answer'.
Restarted the API on port 8002 with PYTHONPATH=src and verified the live stack.

root_cause: Before fix, regression test left /task/active count=1 after a completed stream.
Before fix, active-session 429 returned a string detail, so the UI could not identify run_id or active_task.
Live /task/active initially showed stuck running tasks; after cancellation and restart it returned count=0.
